findings.title: Completed evidence displays a stale missing-evidence receipt state without explanation
findings.evidence: Site A History shows Status completed, Evidence complete, and Receipt state performed_missing_evidence together after successful evidence finalization; observed both widths on synthetic admin/assistant/late entries. This is a presentation ambiguity, not evidence of failed backend finalization.
findings.acceptance: Distinguish immutable initial receipt state from current evidence satisfaction with plain language; completed evidence must not appear currently missing.
